read_when: you build or bundle with Quillbar

43d2fddf.text: Quillbar embeds environment variables at build time, so changing one needs a rebuild, not a restart.

48a33bff.text: Quillbar's watch mode silently stops when the config file is renamed; restart it after renaming the config.

ae8020aa.text: Quillbar caches transforms under .quill-cache; clear it after upgrading a plugin or stale output appears.
